title: Discharging a 470 μF capacitor through 10 kΩ
caption: V = V₀e^{−t/RC} with RC = 10.0 kΩ × 470 μF = 4.7 s. After one time constant the voltage has fallen to 37% (3.31 V); after 10 s, 2.13 time constants, V = 9e^{−2.13} = 1.07 V. The curve never reaches zero, and its steepness is greatest at the start.
alt: Graph of capacitor voltage against time: an exponential decay from 9 V with time constant 4.7 s, reaching 1.07 V at 10 s.
description: The horizontal axis is time in seconds; the vertical axis is the capacitor voltage in volts.
The voltage starts at 9 V and decays exponentially with τ = RC = 4.7 s.
At t = τ = 4.7 s, V = 3.31 V (37% of the start).

checks.name: 37% of V₀ after one time constant, τ = RC = 4.7 s
